##Double Approach

Also called a two-space low pincer. This move can work well with an established position in the upper left corner, taking control of the upper side.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 39, Iyama Yuta 9p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Zle03cXJLY&t=175s) and [*Game 54, Nie Weiping 9p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0vZE3xaDXyc&t=213s).
